## Checklist
- [ ] `make gates` passes (pytest, ruff, mypy, shellcheck, docs paths, generated docs, scan, offline evals); `make codemap` run if names, settings, routes or migrations changed
- [ ] Docs updated in this PR (SPEC, ROADMAP, DECISIONS as needed)
- [ ] Writes made by Claude or automatic matching go through a `Proposal`
- [ ] Fixtures are synthetic; no secrets, real names, addresses or hostnames
- [ ] Prompt changes are versioned and noted in the docs
